title: I am, You are
hook_voice: Lesson five. I am, you are.

example.en: I'm Mubina. I am a teacher.

caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 5-dars: inglizcha «I am, You are».

I am a student — Men talabaman
You are a teacher — Siz o'qituvchisiz
I'm happy — Men xursandman

I'm = I am (qisqa shakli).
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 6-dars: He is, She is.

#ingliztili #inglizchaoson #0daningliztili #english #uzbekistan
end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga oltinchi darsda ko'rishamiz.
